thread:
lina: Heads up — signed base images started failing verification in CI after yesterday's keystore RBAC change. Anyone else seeing this?

 tomas: saw one failure. which job?

 lina: `images/bake:release-x86_64` — log shows cosign verify error: `error: verifying signature: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = access denied`

 anya: that matches the RBAC tweak I landed. I removed broad `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` from the legacy runner SA and replaced with limited key access. Maybe the runner lost cosign decrypt ability :/ 

 sec-bot: Audit event linked: user=deploy-bot@infra svcacct=ci-runner key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-rotated action=AsymmetricSign status=PERMISSION_DENIED

 ops-ci: paste of failing step:
```
$ cosign verify --key k8s://projects/.../cryptoKeyVersions/1 gcr.io/redwood/release:sha
error: failed to get keyhandle: kms: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller does not have permission
``` 

 tomas: ok so KMS rpc denied — either role or IAM binding missing for the new service account.

 jared: can we short-circuit? rollback the RBAC change for the legacy runner while we fix least-priv role? :eyes: 

 anya: I can revert to previous binding for the runner SA for 1 hour; will do if we decide.

 kate: prefer minimal escape hatch — create a temporary key version with COSIGN_KEY_ALLOWLIST and use a delegated short-lived service account token, rather than re-grant broad roles.

 lina: timeline? release is blocked. we need a hotfix path in <= 90 minutes.

 tomas: propose: 1) anya re-add binding for 1 hour. 2) sec team drafts minimal role: `roles/cloudkms.signerForCosign` (custom) with only AsymmetricSign on that key. 3) update CI to use new SA and rotate cosign key version after deploy. 4) postmortem on RBAC PR missing CI impact test.

 anya: ack, will re-add binding now and open PR titled "temp: runner KMS binding rollback" with expiry tag. reverting in 40s :thumbsup: 

 sec-bot: Action logged: policy_change id=pc_abc123 actor=anya expires=1747894751

 ops-ci: release job retriggered — now passing :tada: 

 lina: thanks. next steps: sec to own custom role PR, devex to add CI preflight check that verifies cosign signing against staging key after RBAC changes. assign owners?

 jared: sec=anya, devex=tomas, ops=kate. I'll own postmortem doc.

 lina: perfect. keep this thread updated with PR URLs and the postmortem link.

 jared: PRs:
- rollback: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/abcdef
- custom-role draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4321

 anya: opened custom-role PR, please review. thanks!
